maddeler.e:
نتضادد (form VI)
# نَتَضَادَدُ (nataḍādadu) /na.ta.dˤaː.da.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَضَادَدَ (taḍādada)
# نَتَضَادَدَ (nataḍādada) /na.ta.dˤaː.da.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَضَادَدَ (taḍādada)
# نَتَضَادَدْ (nataḍādad) /na.ta.dˤaː.dad/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَضَادَدَ (taḍādada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
